notes.title: Happy new year from Mindworks, and things to expect in 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217963/d790eeb5583ad5f68aec91c909aa991210e29028.png[/img]



[h1][b]Before 2022 ends, here is a list of the things to expect in 2023! 👀👇
[/b][/h1]

🟣Chapter 3 release: It's gonna be a very long and heavy chapter, good people will turn out bad, and some certain long lasting friends will be broken up👀 who are they? I will not say🤟🏻

🔵 Role calls for character voice actors: I will most definitely be opening casting roles for character voice actors so stay tuned!

🟣Addition of translations: most of you requested that translation to be added and that's  exactly what i will work on! I will also be casting role calls for that

🔵More giveaways or contests

🟣Extra content: such as artbooks, extra comics, or story books. They will most likely be paid content! ... and may be included as the giveaway or contest prizes👀...

🔵Role calls for colorists: to speed up my production process and to avoid being burnt out, I will ask for help regarding coloring, so stay tuned for that

🎉let me know what else you would like to see more of in 2023! I'm open for suggestions 🎉

Wishing you a happy and fulfilling 2023, set it as the year to officially take care of yourself and putting your needs and health first 🥰

notes.title: Mindworks: List of new updates!
notes.content:
Mindworks new version is out now! The updates include:



[h1]1: PROFANITY FILTER[/h1]
A few people requested this feature to be added! its a button that gives you the option to censor swear words or not. It is toggled off by default, so you can head over to the settings menu to enable it (or not)

Without profanity filter:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217963/9b02547357cd41b229c4578b5a8d93004fc25ff1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217963/20439956ca2a1a5a606965c8d3f8202b8ec87fb8.png[/img]

With profanity filter toggled on:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217963/a37dfcf4d6c395db2890c7a6d031dd309f8fc138.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217963/3607dfc95a0699558c84ed14bc9d4d580043bbad.png[/img]



[h1]2: RESET GAME BUTTON[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217963/7a552c396464a2f254e342658030e4bf80c7bdeb.png[/img]
This is a button that allows you to delete your data and return the game to its original state, also found in the settings menu!

and don't worry about accidently clicking it because you will be prompted with a confirmation screen:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217963/c1eec23838f6065720a62b11b4ca301d2bf9ddc8.png[/img]




[h1]3: HISTORY MENU REMOVED, QUICK MENU REDESIGNED[/h1]
The history menu has been removed because its useless with the back button enabled, plus its facing alot of glitches. It might be added in the near future if its been fully fixed, but to ensure a good playing experience, it has been removed and the quick menu has been redesigned into something neater and more visually pleasing



Old quick menu:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217963/e76e94e7b0ca7cd5b6e9ccaea2aeba234ab65b79.png[/img]

New quick menu:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217963/11efcba8b74aeb39fbcdd99ece25122c51bf9e78.png[/img]





[h1]4: MINOR UPDATES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed some spelling and grammar issues
[*] Added a new person in the credits menu that has helped me alot with coloring in the early stages of the game as well as beta testing
[/list]

┌── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ──┐
Thank you for all the kind comments and donations for the games! alot of hardwork and love have been put into the project. 
Make sure to rate the game if you havent already and check the official instagram Mindworksgame.official for updates and announcements!

└── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ──┘
